_comment: xuan_wu_country — country-level biome (aggregated) for 玄武帝 (Xuan Wu Country / Black Tortoise Country). CRON-91: created to close the latent biome-source bug where planet_suzaku.json referenced ergenverse:xuan_wu_country but no JSON existed. Templated from xuan_wu_valley (the most-referenced Xuan Wu sub-biome) with country-level aggregation. Canon: 玄武 in Chinese mythology is the Black Tortoise of the North, associated with water and winter — the mod-original country is named for this association and represents a cool-temperate northern region. Prime Directive: this region exists objectively as part of the Er Gen world. (Mod-original country — name follows the Xuan Wu mythological motif; not explicitly named in 仙逆 canon but consistent with the planet's geography.)
